description: Check a passport credential (a vc+jwt issued by Aeroz) against Aeroz's published signing keys. Returns valid:true with the issuer, product id, passportVersion and validFrom when the signature checks out and the credential is an Aeroz Digital Product Passport, or valid:false with the reason (including "revoked by the issuer" and "not an Aeroz passport credential"). A valid result means Aeroz issued exactly this content and has not revoked it; it does not mean the passport is the latest version — compare passportVersion with get_passport. Works without an API key.
name: verify_passport_credential
title: Verify a passport credential
